profile.title: About me
paragraphs: My mother is a classical composer and my father is a mathematics teacher. Growing up with both music and mathematics taught me to listen closely and ask how things work. I bring both habits to my sound engineering and research.

As a child, I sang in the CTS Children’s Choir under conductor Hakwon Yoon and performed at Goyang Aram Nuri and Seoul Arts Center. I kept making music at school, at church, and in bands with friends.
My faith and church community have shaped how I think about caring for others. This is part of why I want to understand the different ways people hear, perform, and take part in music.
I also attend Chulhyun Bae’s writing class at The Chora. Writing helps me reflect on my experiences and understand myself better.
profile.education: After middle school, I took the high school equivalency exam instead of attending high school. At 16, I entered DIMA’s Audio Production department as the top-ranked applicant in the early admissions track. During the pandemic, I ran an online shop. I then completed my military service at the Blue House / Presidential Security Service. Before returning to college, I spent two months in Vancouver and travelled by train to New York. Meeting people from different backgrounds broadened my outlook. I now also teach Korean on Preply.

en.past: I handled live sound for over 200 performances. Seeing how music brings people together sparked my interest in music technology research.
en.now: I measure spatial audio systems and build personalized electronic drums and audio-to-MIDI tools, testing ideas from live sound work.
en.next: I want to help anyone express themselves through music, through responsive AI accompaniment, gesture-based instruments, and audience participation.
en.vision: Help more people make and enjoy music with tools that fit their needs.

ko.past: 200회 이상의 공연에서 믹싱과 음향 시스템을 맡았습니다. 음악으로 사람들이 함께하는 모습을 보며 음악 기술 연구에 관심을 갖게 됐습니다.
ko.now: 공간 음향을 측정하고, 연주자 맞춤 전자드럼과 오디오 MIDI 편집 도구를 만들고 있습니다.
ko.next: 누구나 음악으로 자신을 표현하고 함께 연주할 수 있도록, AI 반주·몸짓으로 연주하는 악기·관객 참여형 공연을 연구하고 싶습니다.
ko.vision: 각자에게 맞는 도구로 더 많은 사람이 음악을 만들고 즐길 수 있도록 돕고 싶습니다.

profile.intro: I work as a live sound engineer and study music technology. My interest in music and mathematics grew into a desire to understand the problems I encounter at live performances and build tools to address them.
profile.originTitle: How live sound led me to research
profile.origin: The same music can sound different depending on the venue and the listener. Mixing performances and tuning systems made me want to measure why this happens and build tools that better suit the people using them.
profile.futureTitle: What I want to study next
profile.future: In graduate school, I want to study sound through both measurements and listening experiences. Building room correction and performer-tailored instruments led me to ask how CI users might discover and choose musical cues that work for them. This direction is at the literature and design stage; participant interviews and prototype evaluation are planned.

profile.future: 대학원에서는 음향 측정과 실제 청취 경험을 함께 살피고 싶습니다. 공간 보정과 연주자 맞춤 악기를 만든 경험에서 출발해, 인공와우 사용자가 자신에게 유효한 음악 단서를 찾고 선택할 수 있는 청취 도구를 연구하려 합니다. 현재는 문헌과 설계안을 정리한 단계이며, 사용자 인터뷰와 프로토타입 평가를 준비할 계획입니다.
